vision.title: Our Vision
paragraphs: To become the global standard for sneaker authentication, making counterfeit sneakers a thing of the past through innovative technology and uncompromising quality.
We envision a world where every sneaker enthusiast and collector can authenticate their prized possessions with confidence, speed, and affordability.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: To deliver fast, affordable, and consistent sneaker authentication through AI-powered analysis combined with expert human verification.
We're committed to protecting the sneaker community from fraud while maintaining transparent pricing and exceptional customer service.

items.title: Cyberport Creative Micro Fund
items.description: Completed the Cyberport Creative Micro Fund (CCMF) programme, which supported the launch of SneakersLite's AI authentication service in Hong Kong.

items.title: Cyberport Incubation Programme
items.description: Admitted to the Cyberport Incubation Programme (CIP). Current R&D focus: generative AI for synthetic counterfeit training data to extend coverage to new brands faster.
